account_wide.description: Cosmetic ownership replicated across servers tied to the same account. Bonus active ONLY on the server where the cosmetic is equipped and valid.

server_bound.description: Cosmetic exists only on the server of origin. Cannot be copied to other servers under any condition.

mixed_origin_handling.hybrid_skin_paid_plus_event: Treat as account_wide for ownership but bonus active only when equipped on the originating server.
mixed_origin_handling.prestige_score: Per-server; account-wide collection aggregation is design-only for future task.
